subject: deriving a single-link-failure-tolerant data plane, then simulating it to diagnose B's route-import contract violation

groups.why_chosen: Deriving two edge-disjoint paths per router tolerates any single link failure, but simulating the network under B's real deny-p policy shows B's import of [B,D] actually violates that fault-tolerance contract.
groups.what_to_learn: the same small network topology redrawn with two different annotation conventions (path arrows vs numbered route lists) to move from design intent to diagnosed behaviour
